For the lcm of a subset to be \(2025\), the subset must contain:
- at least one divisor with \(3^4\), i.e. one of the 3 divisors \(81,405,2025\);
- at least one divisor with \(5^2\), i.e. one of the 5 divisors \(25,75,225,675,2025\).
